props.pre_merge_check: Before any act that lands a run on main (merge, push, or workflow_dispatch), answer: is a run in flight, and is a run merely QUEUED. Where gh exists: gh run list --repo <org>/<repo> --branch main --limit 5 --json workflowName,status,conclusion,headSha, then gh run view <id> --json jobs. Where gh does not, the same read through GitHub MCP (list workflow runs and jobs). Filter by workflowName. Read JOBS, not run status alone: a serial runner keeps run=queued while jobs work. For ci, a queued run on main is NOT superseded, because the group key carries the sha (only pull request runs may be superseded by a newer push to the same PR); for hub-deploy, a queued run is kept and blocks the concurrency group (Vinc#129). Never assert that nothing is in flight without this read. The rule also covers acts that STOP the runner (restart Docker Desktop, restart the runner service, reboot), which destroy in-flight work without landing a new run.
